text.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

translations.asad: CONSIDER the fig and the olive,
translations.sahih: By the fig and the olive

text.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: Verily, We create man in the best conformation;
translations.sahih: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

translations.asad: and thereafter We reduce him to the lowest of low
translations.sahih: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

text.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

translations.asad: excepting only such as attain to faith and do good works: and theirs shall be a reward unending!
translations.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

translations.asad: What, then, [O man,] could henceforth cause thee to give the lie to this moral law?
translations.sahih: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

translations.asad: Is not God the most just of judges?
translations.sahih: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
